newsitem.title: UK: EMI off on inventory, currency concerns.
newsitem.headline: EMI off on inventory, currency concerns.

text.p: Shares in EMI Group continued to fall on on Tuesday, even as the broad market advanced into uncharted territory, amid concerns about bulging U.S. inventories and the strength in the pound, dealers said.
By 1125 GMT, the shares were down 11-1/2p to 1277-1/2.
Today is the fifth consecutive session the shares have dropped and are currently near two-month lows.
They came under renewed selling pressure when BZW downgraded its earnings forecast last week.
The brokerage, one of the last to cut estimates, declined to provide details, but said the downgrade was purely related to currency considerations.
But the BZW analyst also noted that in the U.S., post-Christmas returns to stores have driven inventories higher, which could make for difficult times ahead.
